Specials Gift Cards Financing Cherry CareCredit Affirm Klarna Contact Book Online Medical Spa Staff Meet the rest of the amazing staff at Pellé Medical Spa! Chrissy Horrigan, MSN, APRN, NP-C Medical Director, Advanced Chrissy has been in nursing since 2012 and brings over a decade of experience as both an Aesthetic and Dermatology Nurse Practitioner. She has worked at highly reputable dermatology and medical spa practices, where she honed her clinical expertise and advanced training. Known for her compassionate, client-focused care, Chrissy takes a comprehensive approach to aesthetic medicine. Her advanced understanding of facial anatomy and the aging process allows her to tailor each treatment plan to enhance balance, symmetry, and long-lasting results. She offers a wide range of services from Botox and dermal fillers to advanced skin rejuvenation treatments, including CO2 therapy and Sculptra, always prioritizing subtle results that align with each patient’s unique goals. Amy Starns Practice Manager Amy brings many years of experience in the spa and wellness industry, with a strong background in customer service, leadership, and operations. As Practice Manager, she focuses on creating an exceptional client experience while supporting a team of highly skilled professionals. Her goal is to ensure every client feels heard, cared for, and empowered throughout their experience at Pelle. Kristin Goggin, RN Advanced Injector Kristin is a seasoned nurse with over nine years of experience, holding degrees in Public Health and Nursing from UMass Lowell and Northeastern University. Her clinical expertise spans medical-surgical nursing, women’s health, and IV infusion management. Kristin is also certified in Botox and dermal fillers, having trained with leading brands such as Allergan and Galderma. Skilled in advanced technologies including Sylfirm X and CO2 laser treatments, she is dedicated to delivering safe, personalized care and achieving optimal outcomes for every client. Tonya Binder, BSN, APRN Advanced Practice Registered Nurse Tonya is an experienced advanced practice registered nurse specializing in weight management and metabolic health. With a deep commitment to helping individuals achieve sustainable, long-term health and wellness, Tonya focuses on personalized interventions to support each patient’s unique goals. Drawing on her background in obesity and bariatrics, she provides comprehensive care that addresses the root causes of weight gain, including metabolic, hormonal, and behavioral factors. She is skilled in both pharmacologic and non-pharmacologic strategies to help individuals achieve meaningful, lasting results. Tonya earned her Master of Science in Nursing from Simmons College and maintains board certification through AANC. She is dedicated to continuous learning and to supporting you every step of the way toward optimal health and meaningful, lasting weight loss. Melissa Deignan Medical Assistant, Coolsculpting Specialist Melissa is a Certified Medical Assistant with over a decade of experience in the medical aesthetics and med spa industry, including nearly 10 years of advanced expertise in CoolSculpting. She is knowledgeable, compassionate and dedicated to helping clients achieve their aesthetic goals through carefully tailored, results-driven treatment plans. Known for her warm approach and keen clinical eye, she brings precision and expertise to every CoolSculpting treatment, customizing each plan to yield the best possible results. Her patient-centered care ensures every individual feels supported while working toward optimal outcomes. Jenn Angel Medical Aesthetician Manager, Acne Specialist Jennifer Angel is a licensed esthetician in both New Hampshire and Massachusetts and has built a career in the beauty and skincare industry over the last 16 years. Jennifer graduated with honors from the Laird Institute. She is one of the first two Hydrafacial certified connect masters in NH, having performed over 600 sessions in 2021 and attended HFX in Boston. She is certified in IPL, Chemical Peels, Microneedling and so much more. Jennifer has attended CoolSculpting University and has performed over 500 CoolSculpting procedures. She focuses her practice on results-driven skincare and has had her VI Peel client results published on the online medical platform healthline.com. She is fluent in both English and Spanish. Ava-Loren Innarelli Medical Aesthetician, Lash and Brow Artist Ava-Loren is an experienced Aesthetician with 15 years of education and training in the beauty industry. She holds certifications in GLO2 facials, HydraFacials, chemical peels, brows, lashes, and Davinci teeth whitening. Her specialty is IPL, delivering exceptional results in hair and pigmentation removal. Carrie Renaud Client Relations Coordinator Carrie comes from a healthcare background specializing in wound care, where she developed a strong passion for healing and patient-centered care. Now in the medspa industry, she creates a welcoming experience at the front desk, helping clients schedule appointments and find the services that best meet their needs. Carrie brings light and laughter to the team and is dedicated to ensuring every visit is seamless, comfortable, and personalized. Barbi Cloutier Client Relations Coordinator Barbi is our dedicated Client Relations Coordinator, bringing years of experience in retail, medical administration, and customer-focused care to the Pelle team. Known for her positive energy and unwavering support, she consistently elevates those around her and inspires the team to be their very best. With a deep knowledge of all Pelle services and a wealth of insight, Barbi expertly guides each client to the right provider and treatment to achieve exceptional results. From your first interaction to your final visit, she ensures you feel informed, supported, and genuinely cared for every step of the way. Camila Alejandro Client Relations Coordinator Camila is a proud graduate of The American Academy of Health and Beauty, bringing a strong foundation in skincare and a deep understanding of client needs. She is known for her welcoming presence at Pelle, offering a warm, positive energy and a consistently cheerful demeanor. Highly knowledgeable in all front-desk operations, Camila plays an essential role in creating a seamless and exceptional client experience, we truly couldn’t imagine Pelle without her. Elise Ortiz Client Relations Coordinator Elise brings a unique blend of professional experience in customer service and IT support within the medical field to Pelle Medical Spa. Highly skilled, exceptionally organized, and detail-oriented, she is known for her brilliance paired with a soft, soothing touch in everything she does. She expertly guides clients through each step of their visit, ensuring a seamless, stress-free experience while making every individual feel genuinely cared for and supported from start to finish. The Salon @ Pellé Rebecca Hardison Master Stylist Rebecca Hardison is a two-time winner of the Hippo Press “Best of NH” award and has been honing her craft for over 13 years. She has mastered balayage, creative colors, and extensions, with particular talent for designing formal styles. Rebecca stays current with the latest trends and innovative techniques through regular classes and specialty training. Kait Davis Master Stylist Kait brings over 20 years of hands-on experience in the hair and beauty industry. She is known for her expertise in blonding, dimensional color, wedding hair, and seamless extensions. She is a beautiful person inside and out, genuinely attentive to each client’s needs and dedicated to achieving the best possible outcomes. Jenny Polk Stylist Jenny specializes in custom hair color and styles. She is a Sensory Safe Certified Stylist and holds advanced certifications in Biolage Scalp, Amika Smoothing, and K18 Repair Treatments. She is committed to staying current with the latest trends and techniques through ongoing education. Donna Bellarose Licensed Massage Therapist Donna is a licensed massage therapist and sound healer with extensive training in India, with a concentration on sound healing and vibration. Her expertise allows her to provide therapeutic massage combined with relief for inflammation, hormonal imbalance, depression, insomnia, and stress.
